items.title: main CI failure: main-broken (run 41487561227)
fix(core): route-overrides.json is written in place, not atomically — a crash or concurrent read mid-write silently drops every route override
fix(ai): speech finish-path tables read through the prototype chain — PCM_CODECS, HEADERLESS_ENCODINGS and SpeechStream media types
fix(ai): bedrock-media MIME tables read through the prototype chain — media type "constructor" bypasses the unsupported-type error
fix(routes): thread the credential dimension through restore, escalation, ranking, rate-limit holds and catalog headers (PR #854 follow-up)
fix(core): Copilot device poll interval has no ceiling and slow_down can speed polling up — a large interval makes login expire before the first poll
fix(core): WebSearch cooldownMillis has no upper bound — a Retry-After of 999999999 sidelines a provider for ~31 years
fix(ai): media-type lookups read through the prototype chain — a ".constructor" file or "constructor" media type returns the Object function instead of undefined
fix(core): ModelPlan.readNotes fractional limit in (0,1) returns every note — slice(-0.5) is slice(0), the #542 break between the guarded cases (PR #741)
feat(routes): per-target context ceilings never filter live sessions — the runner never passes requestTokens to the resolver
fix(ai): speech format tables read through the prototype chain — format "constructor" bypasses the unsupported-format rejection in Deepgram, Cartesia and ElevenLabs
fix(ai): open-responses item-ID prefix reads through the prototype chain — an item typed "constructor" mints an ID containing the Object function source
fix(core): device-code expires_in has no upper bound — a millisecond-scale value polls the token endpoint for days (opencode + xAI)
docs(web): document the experimental model_routes config family — routes, schedules, windows, tuning and log are schema-only
feat(routing): automatic multi-credential failover on 429 quota exhaustion via credential.activate
fix(core): DigitalOcean expires_in has no upper bound — a millisecond-scale value wedges the credential for weeks (companion to #892)
fix(core): xAI and Poe expires_in guards have no upper bound — a millisecond-scale value disables refresh for weeks (companion to #879)
fix(ci): check:proto-reads fails on main — variant.ts guarded read is unlisted and its pre-#878 allowlist entry is stale
fix(routes): door-set governance variant remaps + retarget across concrete doors (PR #810 follow-up)
audit(core): shared own-property guard + regression net for prototype-chain dictionary reads (#833 follow-up)
fix(codemode): std.pick reads through the prototype chain — picking "toString" or "constructor" from {} fabricates the key with the inherited function
fix(core): OAuth expires_in stored unvalidated in five providers — negative makes a born-expired credential, an oversized value disables refresh for weeks
fix(core): governance pruning of requested-variant leaves can bypass subagent exclusions for retarget-added leaves (Codex P1 on #871)
fix(core): opencode device-code poll trusts the server interval with no floor — interval 0 or negative busy-polls the token endpoint for the full 10-minute attempt window
fix(core): Variant PROTOCOLS table reads through the prototype chain — a model package named "constructor" resolves to the Object function
fix(core): MCP OAuth toCredential trusts expires_in — a negative value stores a born-expired credential, a millisecond-scale value disables refresh for weeks
fix(core): Copilot model release dates roll calendar-invalid versions over — "2026-02-30" becomes a March 2 release and outranks newer models
feat(routes): per-element (per-target) context limits
fix(core): WellKnown {env:} substitution reads through the prototype chain — "{env:constructor}" injects the Object function into remote-config URLs/headers
fix(core): ModelPlan setPool pools lookup reads through the prototype chain — a pool named "constructor" never takes the ?? {} fallback
feat(codemode): sleep primitive + std async helpers (mapLimit, retry, withTimeout) (design #800, phase 2)
fix(cli): service set port parses with bare Number() — "0x10" stores port 16, "1e3" stores 1000, "8080.0" stores 8080
fix(cli,client): OPENCODE_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS blank reads as 0 — an empty env var silently disables the shutdown drain in both copies of the grace parser

fix(server): PR #596 provider.get embeds models from the unfiltered state record while provider.list embeds only snapshot.available — disabled/stale-connection providers leak their catalog through get
fix(core): ModelGovernance route and variant lookups read through the prototype chain — a route or variant named 'constructor' crashes the governance gate
fix(core): QuotaBurnRate priors lookup reads through the prototype chain — an effort named 'constructor' returns a function as percentPerSession
fix(core): Form validateWhen accepts non-finite when values a number target can never answer — NaN/Infinity make eq never match and neq always match (PR #706)
Meta provider sessions fail with client_attestation_denied (403) despite healthy quota picture
fix(core): QuotaSnapshot per-plan max-age lookup reads through the prototype chain — a plan named 'constructor' never goes stale
fix(ai): Anthropic server-tool-result gate reads through the prototype chain — a block typed "constructor" kills the whole stream
feat(routes): exclusion expressions for plan pool definitions (model on all doors except X)
feat(telemetry): multi-chunk response continuation cost stitching in route_attempt
fix(client,app): client-side session root walks ignore the fork link — a fork splits its family, cost and titlebar root from the source tree
ci(app): e2e app-2 regression specs fail on subagent navigation/timeline visibility — reproduced on unrelated PR #607 (attempts 1+2)
fix(web): docs locale lookups read through the prototype chain — "constructor" and "__proto__" become garbage redirects
